setup.title: Set up on-device AI
setup.body: We download a small model and run it on your device with WebGPU. You can continue with basic extraction if setup fails.
setup.failedHint: On-device AI isn’t available on this device — using basic extraction instead.
setup.backgroundHint: You can use the app now. The model loads in the background; progress may stay at 0% until the download actually starts.
setup.downloadHint: First download is saved in IndexedDB on this device — later visits load much faster.
setup.cachedHint: Weights are already on this device. Warming WebGPU — usually much faster than the first download.
setup.noWebGpu: This browser doesn’t support WebGPU — the full model can’t run here.
setup.webGpuHint: Try desktop Chrome/Edge, or continue with basic extraction.
setup.cdnHint: Model weights download once from an AI model CDN, then run locally.
setup.waitHint: The first download can take a few minutes. Keep this page open.

home.emptyBody: Share a product link into Luqta, or paste text here.
home.balanceEmpty: No prices yet — add prices to see a balance
home.confirmDelete: Remove this product from your wishlist?
home.orderTogether: Can order together from this store · {{count}}

share.title: New catch
share.localOnly: We extract from the text and product link you share. Optional AI runs on-device via WebGPU.
share.corsHint: The store blocked reading the page in the browser (CORS).
share.pasteHint: Paste a product URL or a short description
share.missingShare: Nothing shared yet. Paste a URL or text.

compare.title: Side-by-side
compare.needTwo: Pick at least two products to compare

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Inference runs on your device. Luqta has no backend; data stays in IndexedDB.
settings.modelBody: Needs WebGPU. Weights download once, then stay cached in IndexedDB on this device for faster loads. Without WebGPU, basic extraction is used.
settings.cacheHit: Model weights are cached on this device.
settings.cacheMiss: Model not cached yet — first load downloads then saves locally.
settings.clearCacheConfirm: Delete cached model weights from this device? Next load will download again.
settings.installHint: Install Luqta as a PWA so it appears in your phone’s share sheet.

capture.title: Capture what you see
capture.body: Many shops hide details from automatic reading — but they’re visible on the product page. Capture from there, or type what you see.
capture.blockedTitle: This store hid the page from automatic reading
capture.blockedBody: The info is on the page for your eyes, but Luqta can’t download it. Share the page into Luqta, use the capture shortcut, or type the title and price below.
capture.weakBody: The link alone wasn’t enough. Share from the product page, run the capture shortcut there, or paste the title and price you see.
capture.stepShareBody: On the product page: Share → Luqta. Title, text, and URL arrive together — install the PWA so Luqta appears in the share sheet.
capture.stepExtensionBody: Load the extension/ folder in Chrome or Edge. On a product page, use ＋ Add to Luqta — it reads the live page (what you see).
capture.stepBookmarkBody: The shortcut runs on the shop page itself, reads title/price/description from the live page, then opens Luqta with that data.
capture.mobileHow2: Add a new bookmark (any page), then edit it.
capture.mobileHow3: Paste into the bookmark address (replace the URL with the copied javascript:…).
capture.mobileHow4: Open the product page → open Bookmarks → tap the shortcut. Luqta opens with the details.
capture.desktopHow2: Drag “＋ Capture to Luqta” onto the bar (or paste the copied shortcut as a bookmark).
capture.desktopHow3: On a product page, click the bookmark — Luqta opens with title, price, and text.
capture.pasteBody: Copy the name and price from the shop page into these fields — no need for a perfect link scrape.

browser.title: Capture browser
browser.loading: Opening the page via the extension and reading content…
browser.failed: Could not capture the page via the extension
browser.timeout: Timed out after 45 seconds with no reply from the extension or shop page.
browser.failedHint: Check that the extension is enabled, or open the product and paste the title and price here.
browser.needExtension: This store won’t let the web app read the page. Share it into Luqta, use the capture shortcut on the product page, or install the desktop extension.
browser.extensionHint: The extension opens the link behind the scenes, reads title/price, then returns to Luqta.

progress.title: Extraction progress
progress.noRetry: One attempt only — no automatic retries. A long wait means it’s still working or will time out.
progress.errorHint: Share the product page into Luqta, use the capture shortcut on the shop page, or type the title and price.

wait.readLink: Trying to read the shop page in the browser…
wait.readLinkSlow: Still waiting on the store — if reading isn’t allowed we’ll switch to the extension.
wait.extension: The extension opens a background tab and reads the page (up to ~45 seconds).
wait.extensionSlow: Still waiting on the shop page — normal for slow stores.
wait.extensionAlmostTimeout: Near the time limit. If the extension doesn’t return data, you’ll see a failure.
wait.ai: Spec extraction can take a few seconds… the first model load may take a minute.
wait.aiSlow: The model is still running — not stuck if this is the first load.

details.checkingLink: Trying to read the product page…
details.pageReadProxy: Read page via local dev proxy (CORS bypass)
details.pageReadReader: Read page via reader (mobile / CORS bypass)
details.corsBlocked: Store blocked direct read (CORS) — trying the extension
details.insecureLink: This link is not secure (http). The browser blocked it from a secure (https) page. Use an https link, or paste the title and price.
details.couldNotReadPage: Couldn’t read the product page — nothing to extract.
details.scraping: Opening the page in a background tab…
details.usingSharedText: Using text shared with the link
details.noUrl: No URL — extracting from text only
details.aiWaitingEngine: Loading/warming the on-device model (first time can be slow)…
details.weakResult: No clear title found — share the page, use the capture shortcut, or type the name and price
details.shopWall: This shop blocked automatic reading (privacy / bot wall). Share the product page into Luqta, use the capture shortcut on Noon, or type the price you see.
details.partialFromLink: Got a name from the link — add the price with share, the capture shortcut, or the fields below

errors.extractFailed: Extraction failed. Check the text and try again.
